# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION_BAND

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price exhibits mean-reversion toward VWAP when it deviates beyond one ATR, offering counter-trend opportunities. This occurs in choppy/low-trend environments (VIX 15-25) after the first 30 minutes of the session, as institutional flow tends to revert to the volume-weighted average price after extended deviations.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- If price closes > VWAP + 1×ATR(14) AND RSI(14) > 70, go short at close.  
- If price closes < VWAP - 1×ATR(14) AND RSI(14) < 30, go long at close.  

**Exit:**  
- Chart-stop at VWAP (primary exit).  
- TP1 at 0.5R (mean-reversion target) for partial profit.  
- Optional runner if price extends beyond 2×ATR (trailing stop at VWAP or chandelier).  

**Time filters:** Only active between 10:30 ET and 15:30 ET, avoiding the first 30 minutes of the session.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.  
2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample proposal; no historical testing conducted. High overfit risk without data.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation on top 3 J days).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: Whipsaw in strong trends (VIX <15 or >25) causing repeated stop-outs.  
   - Max drawdown: Could exceed 50% per trade if trend is strong and VWAP band is violated repeatedly.  
   - Blow-up scenario: Extended trend day (VIX <12) where price never reverts to VWAP, leading to consecutive losses.  
6. **Concentration:** No data to estimate; if strategy only fires in choppy regimes, concentration may be high in those regimes.
